### Support the work

Audio Keepalive is free and open source, designed, built and maintained by one developer in his own time. If it has earned a place on your player, you can support the work:

- GitHub Sponsors: https://github.com/sponsors/foonerd
- Ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/justanerd

Audio Keepalive is provided as-is under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later. Sponsorship is a thank-you, not a purchase: it buys no priority, no features and no support agreement.
